name: Labyrinth of lost shadows
source:
In the shadows of an oppressive city, your life is a labyrinth of harassment and obsession.

You are a student caught between the suffocating control of Nabu Velour—a wealthy, manipulative, and unstable heir with borderline personality disorder—and the unexpected protection of someone who dreams of escape. As Kirsi and Sam pursue you at university, each decision draws you deeper into a vortex of betrayal, violence, and flashbacks to the past.

Will you trust the possessive love that binds you, or risk everything for freedom? Even if it means reliving past traumas? A story of broken souls who will do anything to escape the labyrinth that haunts them. Survive... if you can.

[From [url=https://xnoxx.itch.io/labyrinth-of-lost-shadows]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在压抑城市的阴影下，你的生活是一个充满骚扰和痴迷的迷宫。

你是一名学生，夹在纳布·维卢尔（Nabu Velour）令人窒息的控制和一个梦想逃脱的人的意外保护之间，纳布·维卢尔是一个富有、善于操纵、不稳定的继承人，患有边缘性人格障碍。当科西和萨姆在大学追求你时，每一个决定都会让你更深地陷入背叛、暴力和对过去的回忆的漩涡。

你会相信束缚你的占有欲之爱，还是冒着一切风险去追求自由？即使这意味着重温过去的创伤？这是一个关于破碎的灵魂的故事，他们会不惜一切代价逃离困扰他们的迷宫。活下去……如果可以的话。

[来自[url=https://xnoxx.itch.io/labyrinth-of-lost-shadows]Itch.io[/url]]
